title: Idolatry of Sanjyna
description: Idolatry of Sanjyna — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Chuck McBarris

Quest Type: Search

Quest Description: Find and destroy Sanjyna in H.E.L.L.A.. Enter the Kr'yzz'stal F'yzz'ortress and despatch the heroes there.

Quest Reward: 6250 Gold 1 KC

Return to: Chuck McBarris

Next Quest Given: False Idolatries

Repeatable: No

Tip: More complicated than just killing the Hero. After he is dispatched, look around the landscape for an unusual feature. Enter it and you will encounter two Champions and a Hero to despatch, and a quest object. After you grab the loot be sure to look around for a bit of fun in some NPC's.

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Find and kill Sanjyna in H.E.L.L.A. off of the 4th Level of Frump's Misfortune. Enter into the Kr'yzz'tal F'yzz'ortress to Kill Villain Hung, Villain Shatner, and Floored-Wrench Lopper Shankins. Retrieve the Kr'yzz'tal Sh'yzz'ard and return it to Chuck McBarris in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort.

Offer:

Some are born great, some achieve greatness, and some have greatness thrust upon 'em. Sanjyna would not qualify as any of those. Sanjyna was just voted as having been great, and got caught up in their own hype.

As you may or may not have heard, there was a conspiracy set into motion by some of the original board members. This was then carried out by the fans to vote for the worst of Dungeon Idol. Our new vote tallying partner Dyebold has shown us that given the will, vote counts can go your way. Needless to say, Sanjyna was eventually voted off.

But there is a new and most nefarious presence involved in this Dungeon Idol chaos. An evil sentient artifact, known as Krunch-Sinn-a-Bun, has come into Sanjyna's possesion. The artifact draws power from the stage lights, and even though Sanjyna has been voted off of Dungeon Idol, the artifact is so powerful that it is only a matter of time before Sanjyna is back in the bright lights. Kruhnchi-Sinn-a-Bun, also known as the Kr'yzz'tal Sh'yzz'ard, has the power to mesmerize anyone that looks into it and allows the wearer to control them. Do you understand now? Sanjyna cannot be allowed to have this artifact!

The Kr'yzz'tal Sh'yzz'ard can erect a huge tower made out of crystal, and that is where you must go. There are three liches that guard the tower and you must deal with them as well and only by defeating them will you get the Kr'yzz'tal Sh'yzz'ard. Once you have done this epic deed return to me, Chuck McBarris, in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort.

Turn-in:

Thank goodness that's over with. I want to thank you for putting an end to that so-called Dungeon Idol and saving our show from being cancelled.

Objectives:

  • Sanjyna's Death
  • Enter the Kr'yzz'tal F'yzz'ortress
  • Villain Hung's Death
  • Villain Shatner's Death
  • Floored-Wrench Lopper Shankins's Death
  • Retrieve the Kr'yzz'tal Sh'yzz'ard ×1

Client level range: 25–45
